pages.description: A black-and-white photographic print mounted against a solid black backing, occupying nearly the full frame. The photograph shows a single manufactured object photographed against a plain light gray studio backdrop with a soft curved gradient of shadow behind it. The object is disc-shaped or lens-shaped in profile, oriented horizontally with its widest axis running left to right. The lower body is a smooth, symmetrical convex dome with a metallic or painted surface bearing subtle scratches and reflections. Along the lower rim are several dark rectangular slots or vents evenly spaced. From the right side a straight cylindrical rod or spindle projects outward, likely a mounting shaft. Rising from the top left portion of the disc is a tall, dark, curved vertical fin or vane resembling a shark-fin or sail shape, with a smooth rounded leading edge and lighter worn or scuffed patches on its surface. The object rests such that the fin points upward-left and the disc body extends to the right. The photographic print has a white border. Visible damage includes a crease or scratch at the lower left corner and light surface handling marks. No text, captions, stamps, or handwriting are visible on the page.

The disc-shaped object dominates the frame and appears to be a heavy, dished or domed metal plate or cover. Around its circumference runs a raised rim or flange. Set into the outer portion of the disc are a series of triangular or wedge-shaped cutouts/slots (dark recessed triangles) arranged radially around the perimeter, giving a fan or gear-like appearance. Small dark spots (bolt holes or rivets) are visible near the rim at intervals. The surface of the disc shows scratches, mottled texture, staining, and wear, indicating a used or aged metal object with a rough cast or worked surface. A short cylindrical rod or bar protrudes from the lower-left edge of the disc, extending outward beyond the rim. The object casts a shadow onto the flat gray surface behind it, suggesting it is resting on or leaning against a plain backdrop under directional lighting.
